meta.title: Support — GitKittie
meta.description: Support and troubleshooting for GitKittie Folder, GitKittie Kanban and GitKittie Bud. Most issues come down to git, token access, repository URLs, or folder permissions.

title: Support
intro: GitKittie Folder, GitKittie Kanban and GitKittie Bud are small, local-first apps. Most issues come down to git, token access, repository URLs, or folder permissions. Pick your app below.

steps.title: Verify Git is installed
steps.desc: Open Terminal and run `git --version`. If not found, install Xcode Command Line Tools: `xcode-select --install`.

steps.title: Test GitHub access
steps.desc: Open GitKittie Folder Settings, paste a fine-grained GitHub token, enter the repository URL, and run Test GitHub Access.

steps.title: Check the repository URL
steps.desc: Make sure the URL in GitKittie Folder matches the HTTPS URL on your GitHub repository page. It should start with `https://github.com/`. SSH URLs are available under Advanced settings.

items.title: Folder shows "Error" status
items.desc: Open Settings and check the error message. The most common causes are a missing token, a token without repository access, an incorrect repository URL, or a folder permission that needs to be refreshed.

items.title: Folder shows "Needs attention"
items.desc: There's a Git conflict. Resolve it in your preferred Git client, then resume syncing in GitKittie Folder.

items.title: Changes not appearing on GitHub
items.desc: Check that the folder isn't paused, the sync interval hasn't elapsed yet, and the repository URL is correct. You can force a sync with "Sync Now".

gitkanban.heading: GitKittie Kanban
gitkanban.title: Getting connected
gitkanban.body: GitKittie Kanban is on the Mac App Store and the App Store for iPhone and iPad — one record, so the download button gives you the build for the device you're on. Open the demo board to try it without an account, or connect GitHub, GitLab.com or a self-hosted GitLab. If a repository doesn't show up, check that the token you pasted has repository read and write scope, and that self-hosted GitLab was given its server URL. Anything else — a board that won't load, a card that won't save — send a message and it lands against GitKittie Kanban.

gitbud.heading: GitKittie Bud
gitbud.title: In development
gitbud.body: GitKittie Bud's macOS app isn't on the App Store yet, so there's nothing to install. Send a message to be told when it ships, or to say what you'd want from it.

stillStuck.title: Still stuck?
stillStuck.body: Send a message with the error text from Settings and your macOS version, and it arrives attached to the app it came from. Technical git output is kept in local logs, so sync errors can be diagnosed without exposing details in the menu bar.
